# Accelerate — Full Context for AI Models
> AI strategy and systems for small businesses. We build and manage AI-powered automation for lead capture, customer engagement, content, and reporting. This is the extended version of llms.txt with detailed context about our services, case studies, and frequently asked questions.

## Who We Are

Accelerate is an embedded AI operations team for small businesses. We are not a traditional agency (we don't just hand you a strategy and walk away) and we are not a SaaS platform (we don't give you software and leave you to figure it out). We advise, build, and run AI systems alongside our clients. One team, full accountability.

Founded by John Connor — a tech builder who also runs a roofing company. He built Accelerate because he experienced firsthand the problems small businesses face: missed calls, slow follow-up, manual processes, and marketing that doesn't convert. Every system we build comes from real operational experience.

## Services in Detail

### AI Strategy & Roadmap
We audit how your business runs and show you exactly where AI creates the most value. You get a prioritized plan with tool recommendations, ROI projections, and a clear build sequence. Includes: full business process audit, AI opportunity assessment, tool and platform recommendations, ROI projections per initiative, prioritized implementation roadmap, and risk assessment. Starting at $1,500.

### Workflow Automation
Connect your tools and eliminate the manual handoffs slowing your team down. CRM updates, scheduling, invoicing, onboarding, internal approvals — every repetitive process handled automatically. Includes: workflow audit, CRM integration, automated follow-up sequences, appointment scheduling, invoice reminders, review requests, custom Zapier/Make integrations, and monthly reporting. Starting at $2,500 + $300/mo.

### Sales & Marketing Automation
Inquiries scored and routed the moment they come in. Follow-up sequences that run without you. Email campaigns, social scheduling, and pipeline management. Includes: pipeline automation, email campaign design, social media scheduling, inquiry scoring and routing, multi-step follow-up sequences, conversion tracking, A/B testing, and monthly reporting. Starting at $2,500 + $300/mo.

### Customer Engagement
Instant responses to inquiries via AI chat trained on your business. Automated appointment booking, review requests, and re-engagement campaigns. Multi-channel deployment across web, SMS, and email. Includes: custom AI agent, natural language handling, appointment booking integration, inquiry qualification, human handoff, review request automation, re-engagement campaigns, and conversation analytics. Starting at $1,500 + $300/mo.

### Content Creation
Systematic content in your voice across every channel. Blog posts, social media, email newsletters — consistent output on a real schedule, without a marketing hire. Includes: content strategy, editorial calendar, SEO-optimized blog posts, social media content, email newsletter automation, brand voice development, and performance tracking. Starting at $1,500/mo.

### Data & Reporting
One place to see what matters. Custom dashboards, weekly performance digests, pipeline tracking, and trend analysis. Clear answers without logging into six different tools. Includes: custom analytics dashboard, weekly digests, pipeline and revenue tracking, trend analysis, ROI reporting, and competitive benchmarking. Starting at $500/mo.

## Industry Specializations

### Home Services
For contractors, plumbers, roofers, HVAC techs, and home service pros. Common problems: missed calls during jobs, slow estimates, no follow-up for repeat business, outdated websites. Our solutions: AI receptionist (24/7 call answering), online estimate tools, follow-up automation (review requests, seasonal reminders, referral programs), and SEO-optimized websites with local targeting.

### Law Firms
For personal injury, family law, criminal defense, and estate planning firms. Common problems: slow intake losing cases to faster competitors, no after-hours coverage, manual follow-up dropping prospects, generic websites that don't build trust. Our solutions: AI intake system (24/7 case qualification), client onboarding automation, follow-up engine (consultation reminders, nurture sequences), and professional legal websites with practice-area landing pages.

### Professional Services
For accountants, consultants, financial advisors, and professional service firms. Common problems: unpredictable referrals, manual scheduling, no client self-service, no digital acquisition strategy. Our solutions: authority websites with thought leadership, self-service scheduling, client communication automation, and digital client pipelines (Google Ads, content marketing, email nurture).

### Real Estate
For agents, brokerages, and property management. Common problems: prospects going cold in hours, ad spend with no ROI tracking, no long-term nurture, messy contact databases. Our solutions: instant response system (sub-60-second reply), 12-month nurture sequences, listing marketing automation, and agent websites with IDX integration.

## Case Studies

### Farrell Roofing (Home Services)
Challenge: Missing calls during jobs, outdated website, manual estimate follow-up. Solution: Rebuilt website with local SEO, added AI chat agent for 24/7 booking, automated follow-up sequences. Results: Online inquiries went from ~10/month to 50+/month (+4x), response time dropped to under 2 minutes, monthly revenue increased 75%, and after-hours capture went from zero to 24/7.

### SparkBlox (Professional Services)
Challenge: Manual onboarding bottleneck capping growth. Solution: AI-driven intake flow, automated proposals, account provisioning, website rebuild with AI chat. Results: Onboarding time dropped from hours to under 10 minutes (-90%+), client base grew 70% in Q1, admin hours cut from 20+ to ~5 per week, response time under 3 minutes.

### Montoya Capital (Professional Services / Wealth Management)
Challenge: Losing prospects to faster competitors, no after-hours coverage, referral-only growth. Solution: AI-powered response system, personalized follow-up sequences, trust-building website redesign. Results: Consultation rate increased 40%, response time dropped from next business day to under 3 minutes, after-hours capture activated 24/7, new clients increased 2.5x in Q1.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need to understand AI to work with you?**
Not at all. We handle the technical side. You just need to know your business — we figure out where AI fits and how to make it work for you.

**What does it cost?**
Strategy engagements start at $1,500. Automation setups typically range from $2,500 to $7,500 with ongoing management from $300 per month. We scope everything up front so there are no surprises.

**How long until I see results?**
Most clients see their first systems live within one to two weeks. Measurable results — time saved, faster response times, more bookings — usually follow within the first month.

**Will this work with the tools I already use?**
Almost certainly. We integrate with HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, QuickBooks, Calendly, Mailchimp, Slack, Stripe, and hundreds of other tools through Zapier and Make.

**What makes you different from an agency or a SaaS platform?**
Agencies give you a strategy and leave you to execute it. Platforms give you tools and leave you to figure them out. We do both — we advise, build, and run your AI systems alongside you. One team, full accountability.

**Do I have to sign a long-term contract?**
No. Website builds are one-time projects with optional ongoing support. Automations and AI agents are month-to-month after initial setup.

**What industries do you work with?**
We specialize in home services, law firms, professional services, and real estate. Our tools and strategies are built specifically for these industries.
